<section id="policies-racial-justice" aria-labelledby="policies-racial-justice-heading"><h2 id="policies-racial-justice-heading">Racial Justice Covenant</h2><p>Everyone should feel welcome, respected and valued. The Diocese of Guildford's Racial Justice Covenant encourages churches to challenge racism, promote equality and build communities where people of every racial and cultural background can belong.</p><ul><li><a href="https://d3hgrlq6yacptf.cloudfront.net/64512e98ef5d6/content/pages/documents/racial-justice-covenant-for-pcc-adoption.pdf">Read the 2026 Racial Justice Covenant (PDF)<span aria-hidden="true"> →</span></a></li><li><a href="https://www.cofeguildford.org.uk/mission/growing-diversity/racial-diversity/">Explore diocesan racial justice resources<span aria-hidden="true"> →</span></a></li></ul></section>
